title: Two preserved March 2020 UAF report byte identities and their live access metadata
status: Public-source provenance/access finding, not a new physical collapse result
new_joint_observation: Two already published research source paths are both identified as the March 2020 UAF final report, but their preserved Git LFS pointers record different SHA-256 digests and lengths. Their previously documented source URLs also differ by one hyphen in March2020 versus March-2020. Both exact URLs returned HTTP 200 to fresh HEAD requests, with Content-Length values matching their respective recorded sizes.
why_it_matters: A report edition/hash must be specified when comparing UAF against NIST or joining figures to native model cases. A shared title/date is not a byte-level version identifier. Both earlier research paths and their conclusions remain preserved; this audit does not choose a preferred edition.
interpretive_limits: The distinct historical payload pins were already present separately. The new result is their explicit paired comparison plus fresh status/length observations, not discovery of a new structural defect.
Neither PDF body was downloaded, read, rendered or freshly hashed in this run. Recorded pointer digests must not be relabeled as current downloaded-file digests.
Equal HEAD Content-Length and historical size does not authenticate a current payload hash or prove that its contents are unchanged.
Metadata-only packaging differences, PDF producer settings or substantive page changes are untested alternatives; no one explanation is adopted.
The institutional UAF page currently exposes a shortened Final Report link. This audit captured that link without following it and does not establish which PDF variant it currently selects.

No claim of fraud, replacement, hidden edits, evidence destruction, demolition, legal noncompliance or historical cause follows. Nothing here vindicates NIST or discredits UAF's calculations by association.
next_discriminating_work: With authorized operational source access, compare authenticated copies' PDF metadata, page count, normalized text, complete-page renderings and figure/case crosswalks. Preserve both files and every difference. That content comparison has not been done here.

claim_strength.archived_pointer_and_receipt_difference: A: directly read from exact already published Git blobs
claim_strength.current_HTTP_status_and_declared_lengths: A: directly acquired HEAD response metadata, not PDF content
claim_strength.substantive_report_or_model_difference: D: underdetermined; no body or native-model comparison

source_research_role: Retained original audit in fresh Faraday source-integrity research worktree; this is not accepted engine state or a native-model experiment.
publication_role: Separately named redundant public copy of the new audit, with no rewriting of old records.
